Questions site teams ask.

Are you licensed and insured to fly on a live site?

Yes. We hold the CAA General Visual Line of Sight Certificate and the A2 Certificate of Competency, carry £10M public liability insurance, and provide a risk assessment and method statement before every shoot.

Will you complete our site induction?

Yes. We complete your induction, wear the PPE your site requires and follow your site rules. We work with the site manager to agree when and where we fly.

Can you fly near cranes, scaffold or the public?

Each flight is planned around the site in the RAMS. We coordinate with the site manager and any crane operators, and keep clear of the public and live work areas.

What happens if the weather is bad?

Drones can't fly safely in strong wind or heavy rain. We watch the forecast and agree a backup date with you, so your programme of visits stays on track.

How quickly do we get the footage?

Within one week of each visit, at the latest. If you need stills sooner for a meeting or report, just ask.

Where do you work?

We're based in Herne Bay, Kent, and work across the South East, London and the rest of the UK.

Can we use the films in our own marketing?

Yes. You can use the films across your website, social media, sales material and investor updates. The details are set out in our agreement before work starts.
